crossRefs.note: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together…
They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
The Lord Yahweh has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was…
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge…
Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers…
The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.
Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and…
Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”
translations.bsb: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
translations.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
translations.asv: And when he had said this, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
